hide-on-scroll.description:
Hides on downward page scroll and reveals on upward scroll or when an
action receives focus. Use for secondary actions where content needs room.

label.description: Accessible name for the group, such as "Formatting". Supply it in the page's language.

orientation.description: Layout and keyboard axis. Set vertical for a floating column. Docked is always horizontal.

tone.description: Surface palette. Use vibrant to emphasize the toolbar with an accent tint.

variant.description:
Floating leaves placement to the page. Docked fixes the surface to the
viewport's bottom edge. Reserve space below the content when docking.

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.

--ki-toolbar-backdrop-filter.description: Complete backdrop filter behind the surface.

--ki-toolbar-bg-image.description: Optional image above the solid surface color.

--ki-toolbar-docked-radius.description: Corner radius of the docked toolbar.

--ki-toolbar-fab-gap.description: Gap between a floating pill and its companion FAB.

--ki-toolbar-height.description: Minimum height of the docked toolbar before its safe area.

--ki-toolbar-scroll-duration.description: Duration of the scroll visibility transition.

--ki-toolbar-scroll-easing.description: Easing of the scroll visibility transition.

--ki-toolbar-shadow.description: Resting elevation of the floating pill.

--ki-toolbar-vibrant-bg.description: Accent background of the vibrant toolbar.

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

component.description: Brings frequent page actions together in a floating pill or docked surface.

toolbar.description: The named surface containing the grouped actions.

slots.description:
Direct ki-button, ki-icon-button (including toggles), native button
and ki-divider children. Give every icon-only action an accessible name.

fab.description:
A companion ki-fab for the floating variant. It follows the
toolbar and has its own Tab stop.
